Shinkansen 02

Step-free guide

Platforms14–17

ElevatorエレベーターTwo lifts

There are two lifts, one for each platform — not one lift for the whole station. JR Central’s own barrier-free table confirms a lift and both up and down escalators on each.

APlatform 14–15
Towards Tokyo. Lift, up escalator and down escalator all confirmed.
BPlatform 16–17
Towards Kyoto, Shin-Osaka and Hakata. Lift, up escalator and down escalator all confirmed.
Gate to train
JR Central rates this route as usable without a helper, door to door.

Accessible toilet車椅子トイレTwo toilets

There are two wheelchair-accessible toilets, one on each side of the Shinkansen barrier — not just the one inside. JR Central’s own toilet table confirms a baby seat and an ostomate fitting at both.

AInside the Shinkansen gates
Wheelchair-accessible, with a baby seat and an ostomate fitting — confirmed.
BOutside the gates (JR side)
Also wheelchair-accessible, with a baby seat and an ostomate fitting.
Also at the station
A third accessible toilet, inside the JR local-line gates, with the same fittings — see the JR page.
Exact position
Not published in text for any of the three. Illustrated once we have walked it.The official floor plan marks them, but not clearly enough to describe.

Entrances & exits出入口Taikodori side

Head for 太閤通口 · Taikodori Exit, the west side of the station. The name is on every sign, in Japanese and English.

From the street
Shinkansen North Gate (新幹線北口) and Shinkansen South Gate (新幹線南口).
From a JR train
Use the North or South Transfer Gate (新幹線北乗換口 / 南乗換口) inside the barrier — you do not need to leave.
Meeting someone
The Silver Clock stands on this side and is easy to see across the concourse.
Just outside
Coin lockers, and the Esca underground mall.

Help & information案内Ask before you travel

Staff will take you to the train. If you can, call before the day you travel — JR Central will then tell you which gate is easiest for your platform.

Why call ahead
Some passages close at certain times of day, so the best gate is not always the same one.
JAPAN RAIL PASS
The JR Information office is beside the Shinkansen ticket office.
Waiting area
There is a waiting room inside the gates.

Source · JR Central, Nagoya Station barrier-free information (railway.jr-central.co.jp, official platform-by-platform elevator/escalator and toilet tables) and station plan; Nagoya Station Map (meieki.com), 1F sheet. Checked September 2026.
